title: Emergency response briefing
prompt: A local response team is coordinating around a major storm outage. Which updates should be surfaced first for the next decision window?

contributions.body: Medical device outages should be elevated first because the harm of delay is immediate and severe.
contributions.evidenceText: Some updates belong at the top purely because time matters.

contributions.body: The digest should still surface one logistics constraint, like fuel access, because response plans fail when support assumptions stay hidden.
contributions.evidenceText: Operations drift when support constraints stay buried.

contributions.body: Operators need a briefing artifact they can hand off across shifts without rereading the full thread.
contributions.evidenceText: Shift changes are where context loss becomes dangerous.

responses.body: Exactly. The handoff artifact is part of the intervention, not just paperwork after the fact.
